package.name: growmate_voice
package.description: GrowMate voice + jog interface for the AURA FarmBot ROS2 stack. A FastAPI web app records browser microphone input, runs offline STT, matches the transcript against a fixed command vocabulary, and publishes the corresponding FarmBot command strings to keyboard_topic — making it a drop-in replacement for keyboard_controller. A jog d-pad and FarmBot bringup controls are also exposed in the same UI.
